description: Implement AJAX partial-replacement on Staff Accounts and Inventory List — the two structurally simplest pages. Staff Accounts has no pagination, no filter chips; Inventory List has a stats-grid that must stay outside the results region and a restock modal. Both share the same fetch-replace-pushState pattern and serve as the validated blueprint for the remaining pages.
steps:
1. STAFF ACCOUNTS — templates/accounts/staff_list.html: Wrap
…
in
…
. The .card (with the table and tbody) is the entire replaceable region; there is no pagination and no filter chips on this page. The .filter-bar, page-header, and the Clear tag remain OUTSIDE results-region. The Clear href points to {% url 'accounts:staff_list' %} and stays a plain GET — no JS needed for it.

2. STAFF ACCOUNTS — Replace the auto-search IIFE (the second <script> block in {% block extra_js %}) with an async fetch IIFE. Keep buildUrl() using params q and role exactly as now. Use AbortController: on each new request abort the previous one. Use a sequence counter (let seq = 0; const mySeq = ++seq) to guard against stale responses — only apply a response if mySeq === seq. On success: parse the returned HTML with DOMParser, extract #results-region from the parsed doc, replace the live #results-region innerHTML, then call history.pushState({}, '', url) for dropdown changes and history.replaceState for debounced text input (coalesce typing history). On popstate: read event.state or location.href, fetch, replace region, restore filter control values from the URL params. On network/server error (non-2xx, non-HTML content-type, session expiry redirect to login): keep the existing results intact and show a small dismissable banner inside results-region top (do not replace results-region content on error). Show an accessible aria-live='polite' loading indicator while fetching. Prevent duplicate event listeners (IIFE runs once). Do NOT re-register toggleStaff event handlers — the existing onclick= attributes in the server-rendered HTML are preserved through innerHTML replacement.

3. STAFF ACCOUNTS — Add tests in apps/accounts/tests.py: class StaffListAjaxTests. Test: GET /staff/?q=foo returns 200 and response HTML contains id='results-region'. Test: GET /staff/?role=admin returns 200 and response HTML contains id='results-region'. Use self.client.get(reverse('accounts:staff_list'), {'q': 'foo'}) and assertContains(response, 'id="results-region"').

4. INVENTORY LIST — templates/inventory/list.html: Wrap everything from the alert-warning div (the 'Inventory needs attention' block) through the .card div and the restock modal into a single <div id='results-region'>. Confirm the stats-grid div (the four .stat-card blocks) is ABOVE the filter-bar and ABOVE results-region — it is NOT wrapped. The filter-bar also stays outside. The restock modal (#restock-modal) goes INSIDE results-region because it is generated per-row and must be re-included when results refresh; the modal JS functions (openRestockModal, submitRestock) are defined in the first <script> block which lives outside the IIFE and persists across fetches.

5. INVENTORY LIST — Replace the auto-search IIFE (second <script> in {% block extra_js %}) with an async fetch IIFE. Keep buildUrl() using params q, category, stock_status exactly as now. Same AbortController + sequence guard + pushState/replaceState pattern as Staff Accounts. On popstate: restore #inv-search, #inv-category, #inv-stock-status values from URL params, then fetch. Error handling: same banner pattern. After injecting new HTML, call window.reinitLucide() if available (Lucide icons appear in the alert-warning block that is inside results-region). Do NOT replace the stats-grid — it is outside results-region and is therefore untouched by innerHTML replacement.

6. INVENTORY LIST — Add tests in apps/inventory/tests.py: class InventoryListAjaxTests. Test: GET /inventory/?q=coffee returns 200 and response contains id='results-region'. Test: GET /inventory/?stock_status=out_of_stock returns 200 and assertNotContains(response, 'class="stats-grid"') — confirming the stats-grid is NOT inside the returned results-region fragment (i.e., when the JS replaces only results-region, the stats-grid is left intact). Note: the Django test client returns the full page HTML, so this test asserts that stats-grid appears only ONCE in the response and is NOT a child of results-region (check ordering: stats-grid appears before the results-region open tag in the HTML source).
7. Run: python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.inventory --verbosity=1 and confirm 0 failures.
acceptance_criteria: Typing in #staff-search does not cause a full page reload; #results-region innerHTML changes and focus remains in the input.
Browser Back after a search restores the previous results and filter values.
On Inventory List, the four .stat-card summary cards are visually unchanged by any search or filter action.
The restock modal opens and submits correctly after results are replaced.
python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.inventory exits with 0 failures.
GET /accounts/staff/ and GET /inventory/ both return HTML containing id='results-region'.
findings:
CONFIRMED PATTERNS for subsequent FEATs:
- toggleStaff uses onclick= attributes (inline handlers) — survives innerHTML replacement without any re-registration. No delegated handler needed for staff actions.
- openRestockModal and submitRestock are defined in the FIRST <script> block (outside the IIFE), so they persist across results-region innerHTML swaps. The restock modal is inside results-region because server-rendered per-row URLs ({% url 'inventory:restock' product.pk %}) must refresh with results.
- window.reinitLucide() is called after each Inventory List injection — the alert-warning block inside results-region uses Lucide icons (data-lucide='triangle-alert'). Pattern confirmed: call reinitLucide if defined after any innerHTML injection that may include Lucide icon elements.
- History policy implemented: replaceState during debounce typing (coalesces keystrokes), pushState on debounce commit and dropdown changes, no push/replace during popstate handler. isPopstate flag guards against double-writes.
- Error banner: prepended to results-region top as aria-live='polite' role='alert' div with dismiss button. Does NOT replace results-region content — existing results stay intact on error.
- Session expiry detection: checks for id='login-form' or name='username' in response body — show error banner, do not inject login page HTML.
- AbortController pattern: abort previous controller before each new request; seq counter guards stale responses.
- Test slugs used: 'drinks-ajax' for Inventory List AJAX tests to avoid collision with existing 'drinks', 'drinks-flt', 'drinks-as' slugs in the same test DB.
- The accounts test suite (115 tests) is slow (~3-4 min for full run) due to image/session/brute-force tests. Run targeted classes for faster iteration.
- manage.py check exits 0 (non-zero PowerShell exit code is due to Python warnings on stderr, not actual errors).
